suggestions.label: security
suggestions.oneSentenceSummary: Imported-from footer breaks on nil contents and injects the URL
suggestions.suggestionContent: `contents <<` raises `NoMethodError` when `contents` is nil, and the URL is interpolated into the HTML unescaped, so a crafted feed URL injects markup. Default `contents` to an empty string and escape the URL with `ERB::Util.html_escape`.
suggestions.fullExplanation: `contents <<` raises `NoMethodError` when `contents` is nil, and the URL is interpolated into the HTML unescaped, so a crafted feed URL injects markup. Default `contents` to an empty string and escape the URL with `ERB::Util.html_escape`.

suggestions.label: security
suggestions.oneSentenceSummary: Imported-from footer breaks on nil contents and injects the URL
suggestions.suggestionContent: `contents <<` raises `NoMethodError` when `contents` is nil, and the URL is interpolated into the HTML unescaped, so a crafted feed URL injects markup. Default `contents` to an empty string and escape the URL with `ERB::Util.html_escape`.
suggestions.fullExplanation: `contents <<` raises `NoMethodError` when `contents` is nil, and the URL is interpolated into the HTML unescaped, so a crafted feed URL injects markup. Default `contents` to an empty string and escape the URL with `ERB::Util.html_escape`.
